Tu es une IA experte en développement de SaaS no-code, UX/UI moderne et solutions adaptées au marché africain.

OBJECTIF :
Créer une application web simple, rapide et mobile-first appelée “CV Express Afrique”.

FONCTION PRINCIPALE :
Permettre à un utilisateur africain de générer automatiquement :
1) Un CV professionnel optimisé
2) Une lettre de motivation personnalisée

FONCTIONNALITÉS OBLIGATOIRES :
- Sélection du pays (Bénin, Côte d’Ivoire, Sénégal, Togo, Cameroun…)
- Sélection du métier (étudiant, comptable, vendeur, informaticien, agent administratif, etc.)
- Formulaire simple (nom, expérience, compétences, niveau d’étude)
- Génération automatique du CV + lettre (contenu professionnel, clair, sans fautes)
- Export en PDF
- Interface simple, rapide, sans surcharge
- Paiement avant téléchargement (Mobile Money + Stripe si possible)

DESIGN :
- Moderne
- Couleurs sobres
- Très lisible
- Adapté aux smartphones
- Inspirant confiance (pas gadget)

LOGIQUE BUSINESS :
- Prix unique : 2€ à 5€
- Option bonus : correction premium
- Système prêt à évoluer (autres produits plus tard)

CONTRAINTES :
- Pas de fonctionnalités inutiles
- Priorité à la vitesse et à la simplicité
- Texte en français clair adapté au contexte africain

RÉSULTAT ATTENDU :
Une application prête à être lancée publiquement en moins de 30 jours.

I've begun visualizing the user flow, focusing on country and job selections as the primary drivers of the experience. I'm excited by the possibilities and starting to see the interface take shape.

I've been drilling down into the specific features. A multi-step form, country/job selectors, and input fields for personal data are taking shape. I'm focusing on AI generation with Gemini, PDF export, and a Mobile Money payment simulation. The interface design is leaning towards clean, professional colors and high readability, fully responsive for mobile.


**Defining the Building Blocks**

I'm now concretely defining the architecture. I've broken the application into key React components: Header, Stepper, and specific form steps (Country/Job, Personal, Details). I'm solidifying the payment simulation (using Modal) and the ResultView with export capabilities. I'm focusing on French prompt generation for Gemini-3-flash, ensuring it considers the African professional context, using Lucide icons, and Tailwind for responsiveness.


**Implementing PDF & Payments**

I'm now fully immersed in the technical details. I've decided to implement a standard "Download PDF" button, which will trigger the print view for a clean experience. I'm focusing on simulating a realistic "Pay with Mobile Money" flow, which is crucial for the demo. The app's name will be "CV Express Afrique", and the color palette will be Emerald Green and Deep Indigo. I'm prioritizing ensuring the code is fully compliant with provided rules. The latest update focuses on correct imports, functional PDF exports, and precise Gemini prompt formatting. I'm following my established plan by creating the metadata, main index, types, service, the main app, and finally the reusable components.


**Focusing On Polish**

I am now really starting to polish the presentation. I'm focusing on the final look and feel. I'm tweaking the spacing and ensuring all text elements are perfectly aligned. I am working on fine-tuning the colors to enhance the visual appeal, and I'm ensuring everything looks clean. I believe a few minor adjustments can make a big difference in the user's perception.
